instruction: Disable lock screen notifications on this Ubuntu system.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully enabled Do Not Disturb mode by navigating system tray → Settings → Notifications → toggling the Do Not Disturb switch on. Completed in 5 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open system tray, navigate to Settings app, find Notifications section, toggle switches in GNOME Settings
metadata.task_rationale: Same notifications settings panel but targets a different toggle (Lock Screen Notifications instead of Do Not Disturb). Tests ability to identify and toggle the correct setting.
metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling lock screen notifications via GNOME Settings > Notifications. Evaluator checks gsettings show-in-lock-screen value is false.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly uses 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.notifications show-in-lock-screen' which is the correct GNOME gsettings key for lock screen notifications
Metric 'exact_match' correctly compares the getter output against the expected value
Expected value 'false\n' is correct — gsettings get returns 'false' with a trailing newline when the setting is disabled
Full coverage: the single instruction requirement (disable lock screen notifications) is completely verified by checking the gsettings value
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: config precondition sets 'show-banners' to true but does not explicitly set 'show-in-lock-screen' to true. Consider adding 'gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.notifications show-in-lock-screen true' to the config to ensure the setting starts enabled, guaranteeing the agent must actually perform the action.
